newsitem.title: USA: Sun Hydraulics says Q2 sales to top Q1.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hydraulics says Q2 sales to top Q1.

text.p: Sun Hydraulics Corp said on Wednesday that while sales could have been higher for the first quarter ended March 31, it expected second quarter net sales to increase over first quarter results.
"Sales for the first quarter could have been higher if we had made more progress on the production side of the business," said Clyde Nixon, Sun Hydraulics' president.
"Our shippable backlog continued to grow during the quarter, as we were not able to increase our shipment volumes and take full advantage of our strong demand," he added.
However, Nixon said the company expected to outdo first quarter net sales in the second quarter.
He added, "the increase will be lower than we planned, as it is taking longer than anticipated to reconfigure cartridge valve production and smooth out our new manifold operation."
Sun Hydraulics designs and manufactures screw-in hydraulic cartridge valves and manifolds for global mobile and industrial markets.
